title: Repairs of damaged roofing of vehicle shed at Deep Bhavan, Kochi
summary: Offline sealed quotation (percentage rate) to replace the damaged G.S. sheet roofing and steelwork of the vehicle shed at the Deep Bhavan office campus, Kochi.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Gandhinagar, Kadavanthra P.O., Cochin

sites.name: Deep Bhavan, Kochi (vehicle shed)
sites.work: Repairs of damaged roofing of vehicle shed

scope.item: Dismantling steel work in built up sections (angles, tees, flats, channels) incl. stacking within 50 m; rate 7.13, amount 734.39
Dismantling roofing G.S. sheet incl. ridges, hips, valleys, gutters and disposal of rubbish; rate 208.11, amount 22,475.88

Providing corrugated G.S. sheet roofing 0.80 mm thick, zinc coating >= 275 gm/m2, fixed with polymer coated J/L hooks, bolts and nuts 8 mm, limpet washers, primer and two coats paint on overlaps; rate 1,586.63, amount 171,356.04
Providing ridges or hips 0.80 mm thick, zinc coating >= 275 gm/m2, 60 cm overall width plain G.S. sheet; rate 1,366.78, amount 10,934.24
Structural steel work riveted, bolted or welded in built up sections, trusses and framed work incl. priming coat; rate 168.69, amount 24,122.67
Earth work in excavation by mechanical/manual means incl. disposal up to 50 m lead; rate 223.95, amount 81.63
Cement concrete 1:2:4 (20 mm aggregate) up to plinth level, excluding centering and shuttering; rate 9,940.16, amount 3,623.19
Centering and shuttering for walls incl. pilasters, buttresses, plinth and string courses; rate 1,062.97, amount 3,444.02
15 mm cement plaster 1:4 on rough side of single or half brick wall; rate 519.50, amount 561.06
Finishing walls with acrylic smooth exterior paint (two or more coats @ 1.67 ltr/10 sqm over exterior primer @ 0.90 ltr/10 sqm); rate 202.63, amount 218.84
Recovery: scrap value of steel; rate (15.00), amount (1,545.00)

money.performance_security: 5% of quoted amount by DD/FDR from any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; released after completion
money.notes: Estimate is the Annexure-I schedule total of Rs 2,36,006.96 (rates incl. cost index, net of steel scrap recovery). Bidders quote a percentage below/above, inclusive of GST and all charges. No EMD mentioned. No escalation permitted.

period.completion: 01 month from date of issue of work order

eligibility: No eligibility criteria printed; bidder to submit PAN card copy and bank account details for payment
L1 decided on lowest amount quoted
specs: Corrugated G.S. roofing sheet 0.80 mm, zinc coating not less than 275 gm/m2, 8 mm polymer coated J/L hooks with G.I. limpet and bitumen washers
notes: Scanned bilingual NIQ with Annexure-I schedule and Annexure-II terms (34 clauses). Blank forms and site inspection 18.02.2026 to 05.03.2026. Submission deadline inconsistent: Hindi notice says 06.03.2026 by 17:00, English notice and terms say 06.03.2026 by 15:00. Opening date not printed. Hindi text of clause 31 duplicates clause 30 while the English differs.
